description: "Received the Hibah Riset dan Pembuatan Artikel Publikasi 2026 from Sekolah Vokasi UGM (Competitive cluster) for an intelligent root cause analysis system for network faults."
date: 2026-04-01

In April 2026 I received the **Hibah Riset dan Pembuatan Artikel Publikasi 2026** (Research and Publication Article Grant 2026) from [Sekolah Vokasi, Universitas Gadjah Mada](https://sv.ugm.ac.id/), under the **Competitive (Kompetitif)** cluster.

The grant funds my project **[Intelligent Root Cause Analysis System for Network Faults](../../research.qmd#project-rca-network-faults)**, which combines time-series analysis of network telemetry with a large language model to identify, and explain, the underlying cause of network faults.

Students interested in contributing can find open positions and related thesis topics on the [Research](../../research.qmd#join) page.
